title: Same moment or same wall clock

blocks.text: A calendar app stores each meeting as a `ZonedDateTime` in its organiser's zone. Write two methods on `Meetings`:

items: `forAttendee(ZonedDateTime meeting, ZoneId attendee)`: the meeting as an attendee in `attendee` sees it. It is the **same moment**, read on the attendee's own clock, and that can be another calendar day.

`reschedule(ZonedDateTime meeting, ZoneId newZone)`: the organiser moves the meeting to another office and keeps its **wall-clock time**: noon stays noon, now in `newZone`. That is a different moment.

cases.says: Between two zones that share their offsets, both methods keep the time of day and the moment.
Noon in New York is 16:00 for a London attendee, and 20:00 in New York is 09:00 the next day in Tokyo.
A New York noon meeting moved to London is at noon London time, a different moment.

concepts: Two ZonedDateTimes can show different calendar dates and still be the same instant.
withZoneSameInstant keeps the moment and changes the wall clock, while withZoneSameLocal keeps the wall clock and changes the moment.
